Name: Cape Stardew
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/53081229984_4eea308581_o.png[/img]

[size=3][i]Cape Stardew is a work-in-progress expansion focused on exploration, hidden treasures, dangerous sea caverns, and adventure.[/i][/size]

[quote]
[size=3][i]
[b]Cape Stardew: The Ocean's Secret[/b] invites you to uncover the mysteries hidden beneath the waves. Explore a forgotten coastal region filled with dangerous caverns, powerful treasures, hidden lore, unique encounters, and secrets waiting to be discovered.[/i][/size][/quote]

[size=4][b][color=#ffd966]Features At A Glance[/color][/b][/size]

✓ 38+ New Maps
✓ 29+ New Items
✓ 5 Stronger Monsters
✓ 2 New NPCs
✓ Sea Cavern Dungeon
✓ Hidden Treasures & Secrets
✓ Multiplayer Compatible
✓ Stardew Valley Expanded Compatible
